description: Assumption-inclusive, evidence-aware baseband memory-safety CVE dataset.

implementation.policy: Deterministic local classification, explicit missing-evidence memory-bug assumption, identifier-specific canonical links, and curated public-source decisions.

impact_policy.RCE: Requires public confirmation of compromise or demonstrated control-flow/code execution.
impact_policy.Write Primitive: Attacker-influenced input causes a write-capable memory effect. Absolute address/value control is not required: a deterministic single-byte or null-byte overwrite qualifies even when the immediate observed outcome is an assertion or baseband crash. This class does not assert code execution.
impact_policy.DoS: Explicit read/crash memory-safety class or assumed memory bug without public write-capable corruption.
impact_policy.Assumed memory bug: No read/write/lifetime primitive is public. This family includes both records with only generic memory-corruption wording and records retained under the missing-memory-evidence assumption. Impact remains independent: an otherwise confirmed RCE stays RCE; other unknown-primitive cases receive conservative DoS.
impact_policy.E1: A vendor or CVE record states the weakness or potential outcome.
impact_policy.E2: Public evidence reproduces the failure or identifies a function/message-level root cause.
impact_policy.E3: Public evidence characterizes an attacker-relevant memory primitive.
impact_policy.E5: Public evidence demonstrates or explicitly confirms arbitrary code execution under stated attack conditions.
impact_policy.evidence_independence: Evidence level measures information completeness, not impact or criticality.
impact_policy.scope: Primary attack surface is separate from multi-valued RAT and protocol annotations; Multi-RAT is not a catch-all scope.
impact_policy.scope_comparison: Counts measure disclosures in this corpus, not per-device or per-line-of-code vulnerability rates.
impact_policy.missing_memory_evidence: If a record is not explicitly non-memory and no public memory-safety root cause exists, retain it in the Assumed memory bug family. Use conservative DoS unless independent public evidence confirms RCE.
